trajectory_summary: The call opens cold with a customer who explicitly says he doesn't know if he wants solar, and the rep never addresses that ambivalence directly — instead pivoting immediately to logistics. The middle of the call is dominated by an improvised, resourceful three-way call to Dominion Energy to retrieve twelve months of usage data, which succeeds practically but consumes most of the call's runtime. The back half books an appointment cleanly and without friction, but the rep never revisits the customer's stated ambivalence or the freshly-read bill numbers to build any emotional case for showing up.
